comment: No family is set on the jacks: a crossbar carries whatever is patched into it. Two of the module's 21 parameters, the internal mode and the current routing number, are declared with configSwitch but never given a widget (src/B.cpp:153-154), so no click can reach them and they get no line; they are how the mode and routing survive a save. The routings and the function flags are saved in the patch as two strings (src/B.cpp:70-122). The multiply function is special-cased: it starts the output at 10V and multiplies each selected input in at a fifth of its voltage (lines 210-220). The panel prints the eighteen buttons as 1A to 6C and the six inputs and three outputs as numbers and letters.
